meaning.local: Code usable in the unsynced browser prototype; not live cloud integration.
meaning.offline: Read-only discovery or tested offline contract; not authorized execution.
meaning.planned: Not operational and subject to implementation and verification.

modules.title: Project workspace
modules.subtitle: WORKSPACE
modules.description: Project-level organization, separate local histories and repository references.
modules.acceptance: Authenticated cross-device project isolation and verified source relationships.

modules.title: Knowledge core
modules.subtitle: MEMORY
modules.description: Brain dumps, deliberate approval and project-scoped memory previews.
modules.acceptance: Dedicated backend, versioned sources, signed approvals, revocation and two-user isolation.

modules.title: Model network
modules.subtitle: AI MODELS
modules.description: Browse multiple model catalogs. No provider can execute until authorized.
modules.acceptance: Two actually authorized providers with verified quotas, hard zero-dollar guard and tested handoff.

modules.title: Integration hub
modules.subtitle: CONNECTORS
modules.description: Public GitHub metadata, OpenAPI design and future authorized adapters.
modules.acceptance: GitHub App and at least one independently authorized non-GitHub API, revocation and audit.

modules.title: Task orchestration
modules.subtitle: WORKFLOWS
modules.description: Plan tasks using explicit evidence, checkpoints and project ownership.
modules.acceptance: Durable jobs, revision locking, exact action approvals and independently verified completion.

modules.title: Cloud foundation
modules.subtitle: PERSISTENCE
modules.description: Authenticated routes and database contracts, not yet connected to infrastructure.
modules.acceptance: Dedicated backend with applied migrations, authenticated UI and cross-device verified access.
modules.future: Connect the existing owner-scoped API and cloud UI to a dedicated database after security tests.

modules.title: Tool registry
modules.subtitle: TOOLS
modules.description: Inspect public MCP server listings without installing or executing them.
modules.acceptance: Permission-scoped MCP servers with independent capability and injection resistance tests.

modules.title: Voice interface
modules.subtitle: INTERACTION
modules.description: Opt-in browser voice dictation for local brain dumps.
modules.acceptance: Consented interruptible two-way voice and optional desktop wake word with privacy review.

modules.title: Agent runtime
modules.subtitle: AGENTS
modules.description: Delegation, isolation, versioned actions and verifiable completion.
modules.acceptance: Bounded sandboxed execution, replayable checkpoints and independent verification.
modules.future: Durable task workers, sandboxed agents, checkpoints and independent result verification.

modules.title: Automation engine
modules.subtitle: AUTOMATION
modules.description: Scheduled missions, triggers, approvals, retries and controlled execution.
modules.acceptance: Signed triggers, idempotent retries, emergency stop and tested failure recovery.
modules.future: A durable workflow service with signed triggers, idempotency, human approvals and emergency stop.

modules.title: Creative studio
modules.subtitle: GENERATION
modules.description: A unified home for compatible image, video, audio and specialized tools.
modules.acceptance: At least one authorized and tested adapter per claimed output modality and safe artifact storage.
modules.future: Independent multimodal adapters, private artifact storage and provider permission controls.

modules.title: Operations analytics
modules.subtitle: OBSERVABILITY
modules.description: Measured model usage, cost, task quality and integration reliability.
modules.acceptance: Provider billing receipts, scrubbed audit metrics and measured task outcomes.
modules.future: Actual verified telemetry and provider receipts; no fabricated uptime, spending or success rates.

modules.title: Governance
modules.subtitle: SECURITY
modules.description: Exact action grants, sealed credentials, audit trails and fail-closed budgets.
modules.acceptance: Server-enforced authorization, encrypted credential custody and practiced emergency shutdown.
modules.future: Server-enforced identity, secrets vault, active policy enforcement, data lifecycle and incident recovery.

modules.title: Developer platform
modules.subtitle: EXPANSION
modules.description: Build portable skills, agents and reviewed third-party integrations.
modules.acceptance: Stable versioned SDK, signed manifests, sandboxed connector tests and permission review.
modules.future: Versioned API/SDK, permission-scoped connector sandbox, capability tests and controlled publication.
